items.title: David Murray interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 18, 2003
items.q: a friend of mine in the World Saxophone Quartet... he was studying Indian religion, Ravi somebody, I can’t remember.

ctx.x: Uh yes, I did. You know I’ve experimented with other religions, but you know it’s like they say, you come right back to — a friend of mine in the World Saxophone Quartet, I’m not going to say who it is, but you know he was studying Indian religion, Ravi somebody, I can’t remember. And we were in a small earthquake in Berkeley one time and he ran out in his underwear screaming, “Save me Jesus.” So anyway, so I said, “Well what happened to the other religion thing?” He said, “Well I don’t know.” But the fact is,…
Was there a time in your teens where you made a conscious decision that I’m going to try to be a professional musician?
